verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is an opt-out from having individual subscriber data used for AI model training. That is an adjacent privacy control, not a documented way to set retention periods or delete stored prompts, code snippets or session data, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: documented data retention settings or retention periods, user- or admin-initiated deletion of stored Copilot data, independent corroboration of either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Individual subscribers can opt out of having their data used for AI model training at any time
